traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and explicit requirements from docs/stories/006.0-DEV-FILE-VALIDATION.story.md are implemented and verified:
- Core functionality: `valid-story-reference` inspects @story comments and, via `normalizeStoryPath` and existence helpers, validates that references point to existing `.story.md` files when required, with clear diagnostics for missing files and invalid extensions (REQ-FILE-EXISTENCE, REQ-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION). - Quality and safety: File system operations use synchronous fs calls wrapped in try/catch, never throwing to ESLint, and include a caching layer (`fileExistStatusCache`) to reduce IO, covering REQ-ERROR-HANDLING and REQ-PERFORMANCE-OPTIMIZATION. - Integration: The rule operates on `@story` annotations produced by the separate annotation-format rule (005.0) and is wired into the plugin’s configuration as documented, satisfying the Integration AC. - User experience: Meta messages `fileMissing`, `invalidExtension`, `invalidPath`, and `fileAccessError` provide explicit, parameterized error messages that identify the problematic path and, for FS errors, the underlying error text, fulfilling the UX and Error Handling acceptance criteria. - Security and boundaries: Helpers enforce project boundaries and reject traversal/absolute paths outside the project (unless explicitly allowed, and even then checked against boundaries), implementing REQ-SECURITY-VALIDATION and REQ-PROJECT-BOUNDARY as described in the story’s Implementation Notes. - Configurability: Options `storyDirectories`, `allowAbsolutePaths`, and `requireStoryExtension` match the story’s configuration example and are covered by tests, meeting REQ-CONFIGURABLE-PATHS and Documentation AC.
Given the current story text (unchanged from the previous assessment), the existing implementation, comprehensive tests bound to this story, and the latest passing test run, this story is fully implemented: PASSED.
